sloka: अथायान्तं तु मुसलं कार्तवीर्यस्तदार्जुनः ।निपुणं वञ्चयामास सगदो ऽगदविक्रमः ।। ७.३२.४५ ॥
transliteration: athāyāntaṁ tu musalaṁ kārtavīryastadārjunaḥ ।nipuṇaṁ vañcayāmāsa sagado 'gadavikramaḥ ।। 7.32.45 ॥

translations.english: Then, Kartavirya Arjuna, of unimpaired valor and holding his mace, skillfully dodged that incoming mace.
